title: Canonical explorer addresses
responsibility: Maps earlier console addresses into explorer pages and chooses a useful indexed branch or retained commit when none is selected.

inputs.name: defaultCommit.index
inputs.description: The branch and revision entries used to resolve the preferred commit. Only branch heads also present in revisions are eligible; if none match, the first revision or an empty string is used.

inputs.name: defaultCommit.asked
inputs.description: The commit hash to prefer when it appears in index.revisions. Any other value falls through to an indexed branch head or revision.

inputs.name: commitBranch.index
inputs.description: The history index whose matching revision lists containing branches. Only names recorded for that revision matter, with main and master preferred.

inputs.name: commitBranch.commit
inputs.description: The commit hash whose recorded branches are selected. An absent revision or one with no branches yields null.

inputs.name: explorerHome.index
inputs.description: The branch and revision entries used to choose the initial Pages location. Only heads found in revisions count; otherwise the first revision is used, and an empty history yields undefined.

inputs.name: explorerExact.path
inputs.description: An explorer path, excluding the route base. Trailing slashes are removed before parsing, and the value is exact only when a route parses and its canonical path matches.

inputs.name: explorerExact.search
inputs.description: The query string passed to explorerRoute, with only tab and helper parameters retained for the canonical comparison. Defaults to the empty string.

inputs.name: explorerAddress.index
inputs.description: The history index used to resolve requested commits and branch fallback locations. A selected commit is honored only if it appears in revisions.

inputs.name: explorerAddress.path
inputs.description: The path after the console base, which may be root, a prior console page, a reports or analytics route, or an explorer route. Exact explorer routes and unrecognized paths return undefined.

inputs.name: explorerAddress.search
inputs.description: The query used to read commit, supported view, a lowercase 40-character base hash, and unit fields; explorer routes also receive tab and helper values. Defaults to the empty string.

inputs.name: consoleCanonical.index
inputs.description: The history index passed to explorerAddress for the URL path. It determines whether selected commits are retained and which indexed branch or revision supplies the fallback.

inputs.name: consoleCanonical.url
inputs.description: The URL whose pathname and search are parsed after slicing base.length characters from the pathname. The code does not check that the pathname starts with base.

inputs.name: consoleCanonical.base
inputs.description: The route prefix removed by slicing that many characters from url.pathname and added to any resolved explorer path. The prefix is not checked against the start of the pathname.

outputs.name: defaultCommit
outputs.description: The asked commit when indexed; otherwise the head of the first indexed main or master branch, another indexed branch head, the first revision, or an empty string. A branch head is eligible only if its commit is in revisions.

outputs.name: commitBranch
outputs.description: The preferred main or master branch recorded on the commit's revision, otherwise its first recorded branch. Returns null when the revision or its branch list is absent.

outputs.name: explorerHome
outputs.description: A Pages location at the first indexed main or master branch tip or the first other indexed branch tip; if no branch tip is indexed, it uses the first revision with a null branch. Returns undefined when revisions is empty.

outputs.name: explorerExact
outputs.description: True when the path parses to a location and its canonical explorer path, plus tab and helper query parameters, equals the path after trailing slashes are removed. Otherwise it is false.

outputs.name: explorerAddress
outputs.description: The canonical explorer path for a root, earlier console page or query, reports or analytics path, or noncanonical explorer route. It returns undefined for an exact explorer route or when no location resolves.

outputs.name: consoleCanonical
outputs.description: The base-prefixed path returned by explorerAddress for a noncanonical URL, or undefined if no replacement resolves. It computes a string and does not navigate or redirect.
